_note: Dataset register (plan WP-083). Data are downloaded into data/external/ (git-ignored) by scripts/fetch_datasets.py; they are never committed. Health data are pseudonymized research data: no re-identification, no linkage, keep only needed files.

datasets.attribution: Hongn et al., Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions, PhysioNet (2025), v1.0.1; Goldberger et al., PhysioBank, PhysioToolkit, and PhysioNet, Circulation 101(23), 2000.
datasets.use: replay / adapter / feature tests; exploratory only (no H1-H3 evidence)

datasets.attribution: Birjandtalab et al., Non-EEG Dataset for Assessment of Neurological Status, PhysioNet; Goldberger et al., Circulation 101(23), 2000.
datasets.use: replay / adapter / feature tests; exploratory only (no H1-H3 evidence)

datasets.title: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset (v1.0.0), S001 runs 1 and 4

datasets.use: replay / adapter / feature tests; exploratory only (no H1-H3 evidence)

datasets.title: xdf-modules example files
datasets.use: replay / adapter / feature tests; exploratory only (no H1-H3 evidence)

datasets.title: GoEmotions: 58k English Reddit comments annotated with 27 emotion categories + neutral (raw rater annotations and the official train/dev/test split)
datasets.attribution: Demszky, Movshovitz-Attias, Ko, Cowen, Nemade, Ravi: GoEmotions: A Dataset of Fine-Grained Emotions, ACL 2020 (arXiv:2005.00547); released by Google Research (google-research/goemotions) under Apache-2.0; Hugging Face card google-research-datasets/go_emotions: apache-2.0.
datasets.personal_data: public Reddit comments with usernames in the raw files; no research consent of the authors; aggregate text research only, never attempt re-identification, never redistribute
datasets.use: preregistered H2 leakage study (docs/research/prereg-goemotions-h2.md); EMO = rater annotations of text (affect_scope CONTENT)

datasets.title: DailyDialog: 13,118 multi-turn English dialogues with per-utterance emotion and dialog act and per-dialog topic (official train/validation/test segmentation)
datasets.attribution: Li, Su, Shen, Li, Cao, Niu: DailyDialog: A Manually Labelled Multi-turn Dialogue Dataset, IJCNLP 2017 (arXiv:1710.03957); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 per the dataset card li2017dailydialog/daily_dialog; original homepage yanran.li/dailydialog offline, zip retrieved from the Internet Archive.
datasets.personal_data: practice dialogues written for English learning; no personal data of identifiable people; non-commercial research use only, never redistributed
datasets.use: preregistered typing-plus-erasure study (docs/research/prereg-dailydialog-erasure.md); EMO = annotated emotion of utterances (affect_scope CONTENT), INT = dialog act, CTX = topic

datasets.title: Open multimodal iEEG-fMRI dataset (OpenNeuro ds003688 v1.0.7), sub-01 clinical sEEG rest run (103 SEEG + ECG/TRIG/MISC channels, 2048 Hz, BIDS-iEEG / BrainVision float32)
datasets.attribution: Berezutskaya, Vansteensel, Aarnoutse, Freudenburg, Piantoni, Branco, Ramsey: Open multimodal iEEG-fMRI dataset from naturalistic stimulation with a short audiovisual film, Sci Data 9, 91 (2022); OpenNeuro doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds003688.v1.0.7
datasets.personal_data: pseudonymized human intracranial recordings (epilepsy patients, UMC Utrecht; Medical Ethical Committee approval and informed consent per the source); no re-identification, no linkage
datasets.use: WP-087 real sEEG replay through the BIDS-iEEG adapter under L4-REPLAY (tests/unit/adapters/neural/test_bids_seeg_real.py)

datasets.title: Human Neuropixels recordings in cortex (DANDI:000397), sub-Pt03 ElectricalSeriesRaw 384 ch int16 at 30 kHz; streamed by HTTP range, never downloaded whole (6.29 GB asset)
datasets.attribution: Paulk, Kfir, Khanna, Mustroph, Trautmann, Soper, Stavisky, Welkenhuysen, Dutta, Shenoy, Hochberg, Richardson, Williams, Cash: Large-scale neural recordings with single neuron resolution using Neuropixels probes in human cortex, Nat Neurosci 25, 252-263 (2022); DANDI:000397 (draft)
datasets.personal_data: pseudonymized intraoperative human recordings; consent basis per Paulk et al. 2022 and the dandiset documentation; tests read only a 1 s x 3 channel slice
datasets.use: WP-088 full-rate raw broadband through the NWB adapter and the threshold-crossing feature
